readback.body: Closes the tag-immutability fail-open found during internal Jankurai 1.6.11 release. Exact head ace088c4810f20b32e7a8901bee1b6c81a9e8212 makes generated pre-receive hooks reject all existing tag updates/deletes even when jeryu-gitd is absent from git-http-backend PATH. New tag and branch creation remain allowed; main remains PR-only. Focused wire test, warnings-denied Clippy, full jeryu-gitd tests, score/security/artifact lanes, and 749/749 workspace tests pass. Requires independent review; no self-approval.
readback.title: fix(gitd): enforce immutable tags without helper
